description: Static map of the Remix IDE interface. Tells the assistant where each capability lives and how to reach it, so it does not have to guess selectors or discover the layout by trial and error. Prefer the `pluginCall` on an area over clicking: it is stable, whereas `dataId` values are DOM details that can change. Use inspect_ui for the live state of whatever is currently on screen; this file is the fixed geography around it.

conventions.dataId: Every interactive element in Remix carries a `data-id` attribute. Address it in CSS as [data-id="<value>"].
conventions.pluginCall: Remix is a plugin engine. `plugin.call(<target>, <method>, ...args)` is the reliable way to drive the IDE; clicking is the fallback when no method exists.
conventions.activation: A plugin must be active before its panel can be focused. `menuicons.select(<name>)` activates and reveals a sidePanel plugin in one step.
conventions.iframes: Plugins with kind 'iframe' render cross-origin. Their internals are invisible to inspect_ui and blank in screenshots — drive them through their plugin methods only.

commonTasks.how: solidity.compile(await fileManager.getCurrentFile()) — or click [data-id="compile-action"] in the top bar.
solidity.getCompilationResult(), or open the Solidity compiler panel and read [data-id="compiledErrors"].
menuicons.select('udapp'), pick the contract in [data-id="contractDropdownContainer"], then Deploy. Check the environment in [data-id="settingsSelectEnvOptions"] first.
fileManager.open / readFile / writeFile. Never type into the editor with type_into_element.
